segments.contextAfter: Full featured iOS All and macOS All app targets. The full iOS app runs in Simulator, and on devices with an Apple Developer membership. This app includes widget extensions that enable users to add a widget to their iOS Home Screen or the macOS Notification Center, and to view their rewards or a favorite smoothie.
